result.reason: The added grant appropriately covers Affiliates and contractors and permits transfer to an M&A successor. However, the operative text leaves unchanged Article IV's directly conflicting right for Licensor to terminate immediately for any breach. The new 'notwithstanding' sentence creates ambiguity rather than cleanly conforming that provision to termination only for an uncured material breach. It also regulates termination of the entire Agreement, rather than narrowly addressing termination or revocation of the licence, potentially affecting unrelated rights. No perpetual and irrevocable treatment is provided if any licence is paid-up. The margin comment does not cure these operative deficiencies.
